metadata.intent: Short labels anchor the artwork. Use the same nouns in instructions. Hardware details, supplied fasteners, quantities and material explanations belong in optional descriptions, not labels.
metadata.stageNames: Successive states of the same workpiece keep a stable plain name where only one is available at a time. Pictures show fitted parts and orientation. Repeated display names are deliberate; internal IDs remain distinct.
metadata.goalKeys: Bare item IDs, full compound expressions, or comma-joined alternative target IDs in source order. No id: prefixes. Each value supplies chapter, oldText and newText, so apply the exact text replacement in that chapter.
scopeNotes: The current wr-bearings entry becomes Bearing tube; the parent implements two separate literal tubes and their recipes. These mappings do not perform that graph change.
New partial-fold IDs and revised first-chapter goals are being authored separately by the parent.
No recipes, artwork, prose paragraphs or underlying identities are changed here.
metadata.itemKeys: Explicit item IDs without id: prefixes. Each value supplies oldName and displayName. Change only declaration display names and matching authored label metadata, not IDs or recipes.
